question_en: Which statements are true? 1) The internal energy of an ideal gas is the sum of the kinetic energies of its molecules. 2) In isothermal compression the internal energy of an ideal gas does not change. 3) A gas does no work in an isobaric process. 4) The temperature of a crystal does not change while it melts.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Ideal gaz ichki energiyasi — molekulalar kinetik energiyalarining yig'indisi. 2) Izotermik siqishda ideal gaz ichki energiyasi o'zgarmaydi. 3) Izobarik jarayonda gaz ish bajarmaydi. 4) Kristall erish davomida temperaturasi o'zgarmaydi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Внутренняя энергия идеального газа — сумма кинетических энергий молекул. 2) При изотермическом сжатии внутренняя энергия идеального газа не меняется. 3) В изобарном процессе газ не совершает работы. 4) Температура кристалла во время плавления не меняется.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 1, 2, 4 to'g'ri; izobarik jarayonda A = pΔV ≠ 0, ish nolga teng bo'lgan jarayon — izoxorik.
Asos: ichki energiya, gaz ishi, erish.

en: 1 is true: the molecules do not interact.
2 is true ($T$ does not change); 4 is true.

distractors.D: 3-fikr noto'g'ri: izobarik jarayonda gaz ish bajaradi

distractors_ru.A: утверждение 4 тоже верно: при плавлении температура не меняется
distractors_ru.D: утверждение 3 неверно: в изобарном процессе газ совершает работу

distractors_en.A: statement 4 is also true: the temperature does not change during melting
distractors_en.C: statement 3 is false, while 1 is true
distractors_en.D: statement 3 is false: a gas does work in an isobaric process
distractors_en.E: statement 3 is false, statement 2 is true

question_en: Choose the SI unit of specific heat capacity.
question_uz: Solishtirma issiqlik sig'imining SI dagi birligini ko'rsating.
question_ru: Укажите единицу удельной теплоёмкости в СИ.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. c = Q/(mΔt), birligi J/(kg·K).
Asos: Q = cmΔt.

distractors.B: J/K — issiqlik sig'imi C = cm birligi
distractors.E: W/kg — massa birligiga to'g'ri keladigan quvvat

distractors_en.A: J/kg is the unit of specific latent heat (heat of combustion)
distractors_en.B: J/K is the unit of heat capacity C = cm
distractors_en.D: J is the unit of quantity of heat
distractors_en.E: W/kg is power per unit mass

question_en: The pressure of a monatomic ideal gas in a $20\ \mathrm{L}$ vessel is $25\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Find the internal energy of the gas ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: $20\ \mathrm{L}$ hajmli idishdagi bir atomli ideal gazning bosimi $25\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Gazning ichki energiyasini toping ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: Давление одноатомного идеального газа в сосуде объёмом $20\ \mathrm{L}$ равно $25\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Найдите внутреннюю энергию газа ($\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. U = (3/2)pV = 1.5 · 25000 · 0.02 = 750 J.
Asos: bir atomli gaz uchun U = (3/2)νRT = (3/2)pV.

distractors.D: bosim kPa da qo'yilgan, Pa ga o'tkazilmagan

distractors_ru.D: давление подставлено в kPa без перевода в Pa

distractors_en.B: pV was taken and the factor 3/2 was lost
distractors_en.C: (5/2)pV is the formula for a diatomic gas
distractors_en.D: the pressure was used in kPa without converting to Pa

question_en: $2\ \mathrm{mol}$ of an ideal gas is heated at constant pressure by $50\ \mathrm{K}$. How much work does the gas do ($\mathrm{J}$)? $R=8.31\ \mathrm{J/(mol\cdot K)}$.
question_uz: $2\ \mathrm{mol}$ ideal gaz o'zgarmas bosimda $50\ \mathrm{K}$ ga isitildi. Gaz qanday ish bajardi ($\mathrm{J}$)? $R=8.31\ \mathrm{J/(mol\cdot K)}$.
question_ru: $2\ \mathrm{mol}$ идеального газа нагрели при постоянном давлении на $50\ \mathrm{K}$. Какую работу совершил газ ($\mathrm{J}$)? $R=8.31\ \mathrm{J/(mol\cdot K)}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. A = νRΔT = 2 · 8.31 · 50 = 831 J.
Asos: izobarik jarayonda pΔV = νRΔT.

rules.ru: Работа при изобарном процессе: $A=\nu R\Delta T$

distractors.B: bu ichki energiya o'zgarishi (3/2)νRΔT, ish emas
distractors.E: ish nolga teng — faqat izoxorik jarayonda

distractors_ru.B: это изменение внутренней энергии (3/2)νRΔT, а не работа
distractors_ru.E: работа равна нулю только в изохорном процессе

distractors_en.A: the amount was taken as 1 mol
distractors_en.B: this is the change in internal energy (3/2)νRΔT, not the work
distractors_en.C: (5/2)νRΔT is the heat supplied, not the work
distractors_en.E: the work is zero only in an isochoric process

question_en: The figure shows a closed cycle of an ideal gas: $p_1=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$, $p_2=300\ \mathrm{kPa}$, $V_1=2\ \mathrm{L}$, $V_2=6\ \mathrm{L}$. Find the total work done by the gas in one cycle ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: Rasmda ideal gaz ustida bajarilgan yopiq sikl ko'rsatilgan: $p_1=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$, $p_2=300\ \mathrm{kPa}$, $V_1=2\ \mathrm{L}$, $V_2=6\ \mathrm{L}$. Bir siklda gaz bajargan to'la ishni toping ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: На рисунке показан замкнутый цикл, совершаемый над идеальным газом: $p_1=100\ \mathrm{kPa}$, $p_2=300\ \mathrm{kPa}$, $V_1=2\ \mathrm{L}$, $V_2=6\ \mathrm{L}$. Найдите полную работу газа за цикл ($\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Sikl ishi — to'rtburchak yuzasi: (300 − 100) · (6 − 2) = 800 J (kPa · L = J).
Asos: ish — p–V diagrammadagi yuza.

rules.en: Work of a cycle is its area: $A=(p_2-p_1)(V_2-V_1)$

distractors.C: kengayish va siqilish ishlari ayirilish o'rniga qo'shilgan
distractors.D: yopiq siklda ΔU = 0, lekin ish nolga teng emas

distractors_ru.C: работы расширения и сжатия сложены вместо вычитания
distractors_ru.D: в замкнутом цикле ΔU = 0, но работа не равна нулю

distractors_en.A: only the expansion work p₂ΔV was taken
distractors_en.B: only the compression work p₁ΔV was taken
distractors_en.C: the expansion and compression works were added instead of subtracted
distractors_en.D: in a closed cycle ΔU = 0, but the work is not zero

question_en: The pressure of a monatomic ideal gas increases $4$ times and its volume decreases $2$ times. By what factor does the internal energy increase?
question_uz: Bir atomli ideal gazning bosimi $4$ marta ortdi, hajmi esa $2$ marta kamaydi. Ichki energiya necha marta ortdi?
question_ru: Давление одноатомного идеального газа увеличилось в $4$ раза, а объём уменьшился в $2$ раза. Во сколько раз увеличилась внутренняя энергия?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. U ∼ pV: U₂/U₁ = 4 · (1/2) = 2.
Asos: U = (3/2)pV.

distractors.D: U faqat T ga bog'liq, lekin T bu yerda o'zgaradi

distractors_ru.D: U зависит только от T, но T здесь меняется

distractors_en.A: the decrease in volume was taken as an increase: 4 · 2
distractors_en.D: U depends only on T, but T changes here
distractors_en.E: only the change in pressure was taken into account

question_en: How much heat is needed to warm $0.5\ \mathrm{kg}$ of water from $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ to $60\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ($\mathrm{kJ}$)? $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
question_uz: $0.5\ \mathrm{kg}$ suvni $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dan $60\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ gacha isitish uchun qancha issiqlik kerak ($\mathrm{kJ}$)? $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
question_ru: Сколько теплоты нужно, чтобы нагреть $0.5\ \mathrm{kg}$ воды от $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ до $60\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ($\mathrm{kJ}$)? $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Q = cmΔt = 4200 · 0.5 · 40 = 84000 J = 84 kJ.
Asos: Q = cmΔt.

distractors.E: J dan kJ ga o'tkazishda 1000 ga ikki marta bo'lingan

distractors_ru.E: при переводе J в kJ деление на 1000 сделано дважды

distractors_en.A: the mass was taken as 1 kg
distractors_en.B: the final temperature 60 was used instead of Δt
distractors_en.D: the initial temperature 20 was used instead of Δt
distractors_en.E: the division by 1000 was done twice when converting J to kJ

question_en: How much heat is needed to melt completely $3\ \mathrm{kg}$ of lead taken at its melting point ($\mathrm{kJ}$)? $\lambda=25\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
question_uz: Erish temperaturasida olingan $3\ \mathrm{kg}$ qo'rg'oshinni to'liq eritish uchun qancha issiqlik kerak ($\mathrm{kJ}$)? $\lambda=25\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
question_ru: Сколько теплоты нужно, чтобы полностью расплавить $3\ \mathrm{kg}$ свинца, взятого при температуре плавления ($\mathrm{kJ}$)? $\lambda=25\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Q = λm = 25 · 3 = 75 kJ; erishda temperatura o'zgarmasa ham issiqlik yutiladi.
Asos: Q = λm.

distractors.E: temperatura o'zgarmaydi, lekin erish uchun issiqlik yutiladi

distractors_ru.E: температура не меняется, но для плавления теплота поглощается

distractors_en.B: λ was divided by the mass
distractors_en.C: the mass was divided by λ
distractors_en.D: the mass was not taken into account
distractors_en.E: the temperature does not change, but heat is absorbed for melting

question_en: How much heat is needed to turn completely into vapour $0.4\ \mathrm{kg}$ of alcohol taken at its boiling point ($\mathrm{kJ}$)? For alcohol $r=0.9\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$.
question_uz: Qaynash temperaturasida olingan $0.4\ \mathrm{kg}$ spirtni to'liq bug'ga aylantirish uchun qancha issiqlik kerak ($\mathrm{kJ}$)? Spirt uchun $r=0.9\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$.
question_ru: Сколько теплоты нужно, чтобы полностью превратить в пар $0.4\ \mathrm{kg}$ спирта, взятого при температуре кипения ($\mathrm{kJ}$)? Для спирта $r=0.9\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$.

distractors.C: qaynashda temperatura o'zgarmaydi, lekin issiqlik yutiladi

distractors_ru.C: при кипении температура не меняется, но теплота поглощается
distractors_ru.E: взято значение r = 2.3 MJ/kg для воды

distractors_en.A: r was divided by the mass
distractors_en.B: the mass was divided by r
distractors_en.C: the temperature does not change during boiling, but heat is absorbed
distractors_en.E: the value r = 2.3 MJ/kg for water was used

question_en: How much heat is released when $300\ \mathrm{g}$ of fuel burns completely ($\mathrm{MJ}$)? $q=44\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$.
question_uz: $300\ \mathrm{g}$ yoqilg'i to'liq yonganda qancha issiqlik ajraladi ($\mathrm{MJ}$)? $q=44\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$.
question_ru: Сколько теплоты выделяется при полном сгорании $300\ \mathrm{g}$ топлива ($\mathrm{MJ}$)? $q=44\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Q = qm = 44 · 0.3 = 13.2 MJ.
Asos: Q = qm.

distractors_en.A: q was divided by the mass
distractors_en.B: the mass was used in grams
distractors_en.C: the mass was taken as 30 g
distractors_en.D: the mass was divided by q

question_en: $1\ \mathrm{kg}$ of water at $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ is poured into $3\ \mathrm{kg}$ of water at $80\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Find the temperature of the mixture ($^\circ\mathrm{C}$). There are no heat losses.
question_uz: $80\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dagi $3\ \mathrm{kg}$ suvga $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dagi $1\ \mathrm{kg}$ suv quyildi. Aralashma temperaturasini toping ($^\circ\mathrm{C}$). Issiqlik yo'qotilmaydi.
question_ru: К $3\ \mathrm{kg}$ воды при $80\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ долили $1\ \mathrm{kg}$ воды при $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Найдите температуру смеси ($^\circ\mathrm{C}$). Потерь теплоты нет.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. θ = (3 · 80 + 1 · 20)/4 = 65 °C.
Asos: issiqlik balansi, bir xil suyuqliklar aralashmasi.

distractors.A: massalar hisobga olinmay oddiy o'rtacha olingan

distractors_ru.A: взято простое среднее без учёта масс

distractors_en.A: a simple average was taken, ignoring the masses

question_en: A copper ball falls from a height of $57\ \mathrm{m}$ and hits the ground. If its mechanical energy turns entirely into its own internal energy, by how many kelvins does the ball warm up? $c=380\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$, $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_uz: Mis sharcha $57\ \mathrm{m}$ balandlikdan tushib, yerga urildi. Uning mexanik energiyasi to'liq o'zining ichki energiyasiga aylansa, sharcha necha kelvinga isiydi? $c=380\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$, $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_ru: Медный шарик упал с высоты $57\ \mathrm{m}$ и ударился о землю. Если его механическая энергия полностью перешла в его внутреннюю энергию, на сколько кельвинов нагреется шарик? $c=380\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$, $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. mgh = cmΔt, massa qisqaradi: Δt = gh/c = 570/380 = 1.5 K.
Asos: mexanik energiyaning ichki energiyaga aylanishi.

distractors_ru.E: вместо деления на c выполнено умножение

distractors_en.B: a factor of 2 was wrongly added: 2gh/c
distractors_en.E: multiplied by c instead of dividing

question_en: The figure shows graphs of the change in temperature of two bodies versus the heat they receive. Find the ratio of the heat capacities of the second and the first body $\frac{C_2}{C_1}$.
question_uz: Rasmda ikki jism temperaturasi o'zgarishining ularga berilgan issiqlik miqdoriga bog'liqlik grafiklari keltirilgan. Ikkinchi jism issiqlik sig'imining birinchi jismnikiga nisbati $\frac{C_2}{C_1}$ ni toping.
question_ru: На рисунке приведены графики зависимости изменения температуры двух тел от полученного ими количества теплоты. Найдите отношение теплоёмкостей второго и первого тела $\frac{C_2}{C_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. C = Q/Δt: C₁ = 20000/40 = 500 J/K, C₂ = 30000/20 = 1500 J/K, nisbat 3.
Asos: issiqlik sig'imi C = Q/Δt.

distractors_en.C: only the ratio of temperature changes was taken
distractors_en.D: only the ratio of the heats was taken

question_en: In how many seconds does $1.6\ \mathrm{kg}$ of water at $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ boil in a kettle of power $2\ \mathrm{kW}$ and efficiency $80$ percent? $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
question_uz: Quvvati $2\ \mathrm{kW}$, FIK i $80$ foiz bo'lgan choynakda $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dagi $1.6\ \mathrm{kg}$ suv necha sekundda qaynaydi? $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
question_ru: За сколько секунд закипит $1.6\ \mathrm{kg}$ воды при $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ в чайнике мощностью $2\ \mathrm{kW}$ с КПД $80$ процентов? $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. ηPt = cmΔt: t = 4200 · 1.6 · 80/(0.8 · 2000) = 336 s.
Asos: FIK η = Q₁/Q, Q = Pt.

distractors.C: Δt = 100 deb olingan, boshlang'ich temperatura unutilgan

distractors_en.B: multiplied by the efficiency instead of dividing
distractors_en.C: Δt = 100 was used, the initial temperature was forgotten
distractors_en.E: the power was used in kW

question_en: $1.4\ \mathrm{kg}$ of ice at $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ is put into $4.6\ \mathrm{kg}$ of water at $80\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Find the final temperature after the ice melts ($^\circ\mathrm{C}$). $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$, $\lambda=330\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
question_uz: $80\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dagi $4.6\ \mathrm{kg}$ suvga $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dagi $1.4\ \mathrm{kg}$ muz solindi. Muz erigach qaror topgan temperaturani toping ($^\circ\mathrm{C}$). $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$, $\lambda=330\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
question_ru: В $4.6\ \mathrm{kg}$ воды при $80\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ положили $1.4\ \mathrm{kg}$ льда при $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Найдите установившуюся температуру после таяния льда ($^\circ\mathrm{C}$). $c=4200\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$, $\lambda=330\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. cm₁(80 − θ) = λm₂ + cm₂θ: 19320(80 − θ) = 462000 + 5880θ, θ = 43 °C.
Asos: issiqlik balansi.

distractors.B: suv bergan issiqlik muzni to'liq eritishga yetadi
distractors.C: erigan muz suvining isishi hisobga olinmagan
distractors.D: massalar hisobga olinmay o'rtacha temperatura olingan

distractors_ru.B: теплоты воды хватает, чтобы растопить весь лёд
distractors_ru.C: не учтён нагрев воды из растаявшего льда
distractors_ru.D: взята средняя температура без учёта масс

distractors_en.A: the heat of melting of the ice was ignored
distractors_en.B: the heat from the water is enough to melt all the ice
distractors_en.C: the warming of the meltwater was ignored
distractors_en.D: a simple average temperature was taken, ignoring the masses
